title: Happy ghost
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id='glow' cx='50%' cy='45%' r='60%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#eafcff'/>
      <stop offset='70%' stop-color='#bdf1ff'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#8fd8f5'/>
    </radialGradient>
    <radialGradient id='cheek' cx='50%' cy='50%' r='50%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ffd0e8' stop-opacity='0.95'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#ffd0e8' stop-opacity='0'/>
    </radialGradient>
  </defs>
  <!-- ghost body -->
  <path d='M22,52 C22,28 34,14 50,14 C66,14 78,28 78,52 L78,78
           C78,82 74,82 71,79 C68,76 64,76 61,79 C58,82 54,82 51,79
           C48,76 44,76 41,79 C38,82 34,82 31,79 C28,76 24,78 22,78 Z'
        fill='url(#glow)' stroke='#8fd8f5' stroke-width='2' stroke-linejoin='round'/>
  <!-- little arms -->
  <ellipse cx='18' cy='55' rx='7' ry='5' fill='#cdeeff' stroke='#8fd8f5' stroke-width='2'/>
  <ellipse cx='82' cy='55' rx='7' ry='5' fill='#cdeeff' stroke='#8fd8f5' stroke-width='2'/>
  <!-- happy eyes -->
  <path d='M38,44 Q43,36 48,44' fill='none' stroke='#2f6b8f' stroke-width='4' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M52,44 Q57,36 62,44' fill='none' stroke='#2f6b8f' stroke-width='4' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- rosy cheeks -->
  <circle cx='34' cy='55' r='6' fill='url(#cheek)'/>
  <circle cx='66' cy='55' r='6' fill='url(#cheek)'/>
  <!-- smile -->
  <path d='M42,58 Q50,68 58,58' fill='none' stroke='#2f6b8f' stroke-width='3.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- sparkle -->
  <path d='M72,24 L74,30 L80,32 L74,34 L72,40 L70,34 L64,32 L70,30 Z' fill='#fff7c2'/>
  <path d='M24,22 L25.5,26 L29.5,27.5 L25.5,29 L24,33 L22.5,29 L18.5,27.5 L22.5,26 Z' fill='#fff7c2'/>
</svg>
